items.sentence: Today, lemon juice is a mild acid found in kitchens.
The small moon follows a wide orbit around the planet.
Today, some bright berries are toxic, so nobody should taste them.
Today, every single atom is far too small to see.
A liquid keeps its volume but changes shape in each container.
Our universe contains stars, planets, moons, and asteroids.
Today, you can reverse the pattern to make a new design.
The metal rod will extend slightly when heated.
Today, nobody knew the full extent of the underground cave.
Today, warm air makes the balloon expand into a round shape.
